The [[Dwarf Ice Ship Captain]] is the captain of the [[ice ship]] at the end of [[Ice Caves of Sorrow]].

==Missions==
*[[Guild Wars Prophecies|Prophecies]]
**[[Southern Shiverpeaks]]
***{{NPC location|Ice Caves of Sorrow}}

==Notes==
*This [[Non-player character|NPC]] only appears for the ending cinematic of the aforementioned mission.
*The Dwarf Ice Ship Captain wields an [[Ascalon Razor]] and a [[Militia Shield]], unlike most dwarven warriors which wield hammers.
